companyUrls.description: LinkedIn company URLs or slugs, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/google/ or google. (mode=companies)
companyUrls.title: Company URLs

datePosted.description: Keep posts published within this window, measured from the run time.
datePosted.title: Date Posted

includeReposts.description: When enabled, reposts and quote posts are kept with their postType and repostOf fields. When disabled, they are dropped.
includeReposts.title: Include Reposts & Quotes

maxItems.description: Global cap on post records in the dataset. Diagnostic error rows are not counted toward this cap.
maxItems.title: Max Posts

maxPostsPerProfile.description: Maximum posts to keep per profile or company. Public profile pages expose about 6-8 recent posts and company home pages 2-10, so larger values do not unlock more history.
maxPostsPerProfile.title: Max Posts Per Target

mediaType.description: Only keep posts of these media types. Public pages reliably expose text, image, video and article; repost is a pure reshare. Leave empty to keep all.
mediaType.title: Media Type Filter

minComments.description: Only keep posts with at least this many comments. Posts without a readable comment count are treated as zero.
minComments.title: Minimum Comments

minReactions.description: Only keep posts with at least this many reactions. Posts without a readable reaction count are treated as zero.
minReactions.title: Minimum Reactions

mode.description: Choose what to scrape: specific public post URLs, a profile's recent posts, or a company's recent posts.
mode.title: Mode

postTypes.description: Legacy type filter. Left at its default of six types it changes nothing; any other selection is merged with mediaType.
postTypes.title: Post Types (legacy)

postUrls.description: Public LinkedIn post URLs, feed-update URLs, activity URNs or numeric activity IDs. (mode=postUrls)
postUrls.title: Post URLs

profileUrls.description: LinkedIn profile URLs or public identifiers, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates/ or williamhgates. (mode=profiles)
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy. Supply one only if your runs are consistently blocked.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
